name: Darrell Steward
prior_offices: Park County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election; re-elected 2026)
background: Darrell Steward is the Park County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 3, 2026, general election. The Powell Tribune reported in June 2026 that he was unopposed in his bid for another term. No separate public-record account of his earlier occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Park County department pages or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
